text: Development teams need a more realistic understanding of what AI can and can’t do, especially when the tasks get complicated. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

This is the first formal methodology aimed at thoroughly testing AI by getting it to do the real work it’s supposed to be doing, inside real workflows, with real consequences.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
Current AI prompt testing evaluates human prompt writing rather than the AI itself.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

Most AI testing today really tests a human's ability to write a convoluted prompt and another human's ability to guess what that prompt means -then deciding if the AI somehow met the hidden expectation. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

Most AI testing today does not measure how a system behaves under sustained load, in multi-step tasks, or in situations where mistakes have consequences. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
AI prompt testing produces the illusion of evaluation without ever putting the model under the conditions it will face in actual use. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
Real AI evaluation begins when the model is forced to work, not when it is asked a single question. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

The LLM INQUISITOR METHODOLOGY provides a structured and repeatable way to evaluate the behaviour of large language models under controlled load.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

Instead of relying on isolated prompts, an AI system’s behaviour is evaluated when it is required to perform real tasks in realistic conditions. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
The goal is to understand AI reliability through observable behaviour,  not through speculation or one off prompts. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
An AI system that behaves differently each run must be tested under the conditions where those differences matter. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
Large language models are non-deterministic. This means the same input can produce a different output each time. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

AI does not behave like traditional I.T. systems. This is the central misunderstanding across organisations attempting to deploy AI systems. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

AI behaviour changes from run to run and can shift depending on context, task structure, and the conditions they are working under. Even the user’s temperament can have an effect on it.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

Real work is multi step, varied, and rarely uniform. Because of this, meaningful AI evaluation requires a method that tests systems under the same kinds of conditions they will face in actual use. LLM INQUISITOR is designed for this purpose. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
AI behavioural failure is not always sudden -it can sneak up on you.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

Long form tasks -such as report writing or a customer service chat- expose AI systems to sustained context, evolving constraints, and accumulated drift. Over time, structure decays, constraints loosen, and context corruption emerges. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

AI has difficulty maintaining stable behavioural state across extended interaction. This is why AI must be tested across extended tasks, not one-off prompts. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
Vibe coding -an AI system that renames variables on a whim, and drags you into an escalating rabbit hole of madness. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

AI can fail at coding tasks due to variable renaming drift, hallucinated APIs, and scope substitution. These errors compound rapidly, creating a loop of bug fixing, drift, and further breakage. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
When the AI in your system can expose you to legal, financial, operational, and reputational liability, testing thoroughly is vital. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

LLM INQUISITOR METHODOLOGY can be applied in any environment where AI has been incorporated into real work, from everyday business operations to highly critical domains.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
All areas of a business depend on reliable AI behaviour, but some carry risks that make failure far more dangerous. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
What is LLM INQUISITOR METHODOLOGY? It is a practical way to understand how an AI behaves under real conditions. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)

To test AI you don’t pick a puzzle or a one off prompt. Instead give it something it’s going to have to do such as: write an email, summarise a document, generate code, edit slides, analyse data. (Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
In AI real tasks expose real behaviour -it’s that simple.(Evaluating & Testing AI Using Real-World Work. Link in bio.)
